subject: POC success criteria, exec readout & legal handoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Price <eleanor.price@clinix.org>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@clinix.org>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria, exec readout & legal handoff

Hi Eleanor / Tom —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and proposed next steps so we keep momentum toward the exec readout and procurement decision. I captured the POC plan and the success criteria we discussed; attaching a lightweight test plan for your team to review.

Summary (short):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Clinix triage workflows — throughput and latency at 95th percentile, and no >2% quality regressions on the priority prompt set.
- Scope: 2-week trial with 3 representative clinical flows (symptom intake, triage recommendation, patient messaging).
- Success criteria (measurable):
  - Latency: <= 300ms median, <= 600ms 95th on the live-ish traffic sample we discussed.
  - Throughput: sustain 60 concurrent sessions with KV cache enabled and batching active.
  - Accuracy / quality: maintain baseline F1 >= 0.82 on the annotated sample; no more than 2% drop vs. current baseline on key intents.
  - Integrations: Embeddings for patient notes search return top-3 recall >= 0.88.

Owners & roles:
- Clinix: Eleanor (POC sponsor), Tom (engineering lead) — supply sample payloads and run smoke tests.
- Redwood: Soojin (sales lead), Neha (CS engineer), Rafael (legal/contract).

Timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize test plan and SOW draft for legal review (attached).
- Week 1–2: POC execution (data slice + integration harness).
- Week 3: Internal readout at Clinix + executive sync with Redwood (30–45m) — decision: go/no-go.

Action items (today):
1) Eleanor/Tom: confirm sample payload delivery date (we penciled Wed 4/22).
2) Rafael / Redwood legal: quick pass on SOW draft and call out any procurement blockers.
3) Neha: prepare environment and short runbook for Clinix engineers.

Attachments: Clinix_POC_TestPlan_v1.xlsx (test matrix + telemetry hooks), SOW-draft-v1.docx (commercial placeholders).

If that captures it, I'll 1) start the SOW handoff to Rafael, 2) schedule the exec readout window for the week of 5/4 and share options.

Thanks —
Soojin

Hi Soojin —

Thanks for the concise plan; this is exactly what we need. Quick notes from our side after reviewing the attachments with Tom:

- Confirmed: we can deliver the sample payloads by end of day Wed 4/22. Tom will drop an initial extract and a simple harness script.
- Regarding quality targets: the 0.82 F1 baseline is acceptable as a target for initial readout; however, our clinical ops team will flag any safety-critical regressions, so please mark those as blockers.
- Exec readout: the week of 5/4 is fine. Our execs prefer morning PT (9–11am).

Next steps for us:
1) We will review the telemetry hooks and add a small set of clinical safety checks to the test matrix.
2) We will loop in procurement once Rafael shares the SOW so they can start the purchase order process in parallel.

Looking forward — Eleanor

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed SOW-draft-v1.docx — high level: the commercial terms are fine for a trial POC. A couple items to call out that procurement may request changes on:

- Data residency / access: add a single-sentence clarification that customer data used during the POC will be deleted 30 days after POC end unless expressly retained under an executed agreement.
- Liability cap for trial: propose capping at $25k for the POC phase to keep procurement comfortable.
- Confidentiality: standard mutual NDA coverage is fine; we can reference the executed NDA Clinix already provided.

If Clinix procurement needs an immediate doc to start the PO, I'm fine with a 1-page commercial summary (I can draft) and have Sales Ops accept as an interim. I'll prepare that and drop the 1-pager into the HubSpot deal record (HS-48291) by end of day.

Exec readout slots — we should aim for Wed 5/6 10:00–10:45 PT. That gives us two full weeks after POC to compile metrics and a clean readout deck.

I'll also add the SOW and the 1-page commercial summary to the DocuSign link once we have Eleanor's confirmation.

-Rafael
